_doc: three.js (r186) API → Godot 4.7 C++ (godot-cpp, the RenderingServer the game's native/src/render uses). One entry per three class the 4.0's features use (scripts/catalog-check.mjs keeps that complete). `rule` is how the value or call is carried; facts marked [parity] were measured by scripts/parity.mjs (three.js and Godot drawing the same program, pixel for pixel), [engine] were read in Godot's source, [docs] in Godot's or three's documentation. `verify` lists the Godot classes and methods the rule relies on; scripts/catalog-check.mjs checks each exists in the Godot binary.
global: Coordinates: both right-handed, +Y up, cameras look down -Z [docs godot-coordinates]: positions, rotations and matrices carry unchanged.
Matrices: three's Matrix4.elements are column-major; Transform3D(Basis(col0.xyz, col1.xyz, col2.xyz), col3.xyz) [parity world-camera, instanced].
Winding: three's front faces are counter-clockwise, Godot's clockwise [docs godot-arraymesh]: every triangle's indices reversed (a, c, b) [parity front-facing].
Depth: Godot Forward+ is reversed Z (1 near); three's window depth is 1 - FRAGCOORD.z, and a depth three writes is DEPTH = 1 - d [parity depth].
Fragment coordinates: Godot's FRAGCOORD origin is the top left; three's gl_FragCoord.y is VIEWPORT_SIZE.y - FRAGCOORD.y [parity fragcoord-discard].

Color: three works in linear sRGB and encodes in the shader; Godot encodes after the fragment: the shader's output transfer is the identity and the Environment's tonemapper is three's toneMapping (Linear for NoToneMapping) [parity basic-material, standard-lit] [docs three-color].

Textures: an sRGB texture (SRGB8_ALPHA8 upload) is a sampler with source_color; NearestFilter → filter_nearest, LinearMipmapLinear → filter_linear_mipmap, ClampToEdge → repeat_disable [parity texture-srgb]. three uploads images with flipY = true by default: the image's rows are flipped once when imported (Godot's UV origin is the image's top row).

Shaders: every program is translated by src/render/godot-shader.ts (one spatial shader, unshaded, three's own lighting) [parity: 19/19 cases]; three's internal textures (dfgLUT) are uniforms the engine uploads [parity standard-lit].

BufferGeometry.rule: Each attribute an ARRAY_* entry by the shader translation's attribute map: position → ARRAY_VERTEX, normal → ARRAY_NORMAL, uv → ARRAY_TEX_UV, uv1 → ARRAY_TEX_UV2, color → ARRAY_COLOR, tangent → ARRAY_TANGENT, skinIndex/skinWeight → ARRAY_BONES/ARRAY_WEIGHTS, others → ARRAY_CUSTOM0–3 (RGBA_FLOAT) or a data texture; index → ARRAY_INDEX with each triangle reversed. groups → one surface per group; boundingBox/Sphere → the mesh's AABB (RenderingServer::mesh_set_custom_aabb).

BufferAttribute.godot: a PackedFloat32Array / PackedVector3Array of an ARRAY_* entry
BufferAttribute.rule: itemSize × count floats; needsUpdate → RenderingServer::mesh_surface_update_vertex_region / update_attribute_region (byte offsets of the surface format); setUsage(DynamicDrawUsage) → ARRAY_FLAG_USE_DYNAMIC_UPDATE.

InterleavedBuffer.godot: the surface's vertex buffer (Godot interleaves by its own format)
InterleavedBuffer.rule: De-interleave into the ARRAY_* entries; Godot packs vertex/attribute streams itself (mesh_surface_get_format_*_stride gives the layout for region updates).

InterleavedBufferAttribute.rule: as InterleavedBuffer: read with offset/stride, written as its own array

InstancedInterleavedBuffer.godot: MultiMesh buffer (3 vec4 rows per 3D transform, then color, then custom) [engine godot-forward-clustered]
InstancedInterleavedBuffer.rule: Per-instance data: instanceMatrix → the transform rows, instanceColor → instance color, ≤4 other floats → custom data (INSTANCE_CUSTOM), more → a data texture by INSTANCE_ID [parity instanced, instanced-custom].

InstancedBufferAttribute.godot: MultiMesh custom data or a data texture

InstancedBufferGeometry.rule: instanceCount → multimesh instance count; per-instance attributes as InstancedBufferAttribute

GLBufferAttribute.godot: RenderingDevice buffer shared with the surface (RenderingServer::mesh_surface_get_... / RD buffer)
GLBufferAttribute.rule: A GPU buffer three does not own: in Godot the surface's vertex buffer through RenderingDevice (RenderingServer::get_rendering_device, mesh_surface data); written by compute or buffer_update.

Object3D.godot: RenderingServer instance (instance_create, instance_set_transform) or a Node3D
Object3D.rule: position/quaternion/scale → Transform3D (Basis from the quaternion, scaled); matrixWorld → the instance transform (column-major elements as Transform3D); visible → instance_set_visible; layers → instance_set_layer_mask; renderOrder → material render_priority; frustumCulled=false → instance_set_extra_visibility_margin / custom AABB; onBeforeRender/onBeforeShadow (feature platform hooks) → per-frame code in the owner's update before drawing (Godot calls no user code per draw).

Group.godot: a parent transform composed into each child instance (or a Node3D)

Mesh.godot: RenderingServer instance with base = mesh, material on the surface
Mesh.rule: material → mesh_surface_set_material or instance_geometry_set_material_override; castShadow/receiveShadow → instance_geometry_set_cast_shadows_setting / the shader's shadows

InstancedMesh.godot: RenderingServer multimesh (TRANSFORM_3D, colors, custom data) [engine godot-forward-clustered]
InstancedMesh.rule: setMatrixAt → multimesh_instance_set_transform (or the buffer's 3 rows); setColorAt → multimesh_instance_set_color (three's linear color); count → multimesh_set_visible_instances; the instance transform is in MODEL_MATRIX before vertex() (instanceMatrix is the identity in the shader) [parity instanced].

BatchedMesh.godot: one MultiMesh per geometry, or one merged mesh with per-draw data
BatchedMesh.rule: Godot has no multi-draw of different geometries in one call: a multimesh per geometry (instances = the batch's instances of it), or the geometries merged into one surface with a per-vertex id reading a data texture of transforms.

LOD.rule: Each level's distance → visibility range begin/end; LOD.update (a platform hook: three's renderer calls it) → Godot's own range selection

Material.godot: RenderingServer material with the translated shader (material_create, material_set_shader, material_set_param)
Material.rule: side → render_mode cull_back/cull_front/cull_disabled; transparent → ALPHA written; depthWrite/depthTest → depth_draw_*/depth_test_disabled; blending (Additive) → blend_add; onBeforeCompile → its edits are in the program the translation reads; uniforms → material_set_param by the translation's uniform map; customProgramCacheKey → one shader per distinct program.

MeshStandardMaterial.godot: the translated MeshStandardMaterial program (exact) [parity standard-lit] — or StandardMaterial3D (Godot's lighting, not three's)
MeshStandardMaterial.rule: Exact: color → diffuse (linear), roughness, metalness, emissive, maps → samplers with their state; lights → three's light uniforms the engine feeds (directionalLights__direction/__color in view space...). Native: StandardMaterial3D albedo_color (sRGB), roughness, metallic, emission; both are metallic-roughness PBR but the BRDFs differ (Godot Burley/GGX).

MeshBasicMaterial.godot: the translated program (exact) [parity basic-material] — or StandardMaterial3D with shading_mode unshaded
MeshBasicMaterial.rule: color → diffuse; map → sampler; vertexColors → COLOR

MeshDepthMaterial.godot: none: Godot renders depth and shadows with the main material (IN_SHADOW_PASS) [docs godot-spatial]
MeshDepthMaterial.rule: A customDepthMaterial's vertex changes belong in the main shader's vertex(); its own program is not drawn in Godot.

ShaderMaterial.rule: The linked program translated (src/render/godot-shader.ts); uniforms by the translation's map [parity: 19 cases].

ShaderChunk.godot: nothing at run time: the chunks are already in the program the translation reads
ShaderChunk.rule: Resolved by three before linking; the captured program holds them.

WebGLProgramParameters.godot: the translated shader's defines (fixed at translation)
WebGLProgramParameters.rule: Each distinct parameter set is a distinct Godot shader

uniforms.rule: by the translation's uniform map (struct arrays as one array per field)

Texture.rule: format/type → Image format (RGBA8, RGH, RGBAF...); colorSpace SRGB → source_color hint; filters and wrap → the sampler's hints; flipY → rows flipped at import; needsUpdate → texture_2d_update

DataTexture.rule: the bytes as uploaded [parity standard-lit dfgLUT, shadow-compare]

CanvasTexture.godot: Image from the canvas's pixels (an Image the engine draws, or a Godot SubViewport)
CanvasTexture.rule: The canvas drawing is UI code: rendered to an Image, uploaded as Texture

DataUtils.godot: Image format conversion (half floats: Image FORMAT_RH/RGH/RGBAH)
DataUtils.rule: toHalfFloat/fromHalfFloat → store halves as Godot's half formats (IEEE 754 binary16, the same encoding)

RenderTarget.rule: A target three draws into → a Godot viewport whose texture is sampled

WebGLRenderer.godot: RenderingServer and the main viewport; post-processing → Compositor/CompositorEffect [docs godot-compositor]
WebGLRenderer.rule: render() → Godot draws every frame; toneMapping → Environment tonemap_mode; outputColorSpace → Godot's own sRGB output; shadowMap → Light3D shadows; compile()/precompile → shader warm-up by drawing once

Camera.rule: matrixWorld → camera transform; projectionMatrix → camera_set_perspective/orthogonal (Godot fov is vertical, as three's)

PerspectiveCamera.godot: camera_set_perspective(fov, near, far) [parity: fov 50, near 0.1, far 100 match]
PerspectiveCamera.rule: fov vertical degrees, aspect from the viewport

OrthographicCamera.rule: left/right from size × aspect; off-centre frustums → camera_set_frustum

Frustum.godot: Godot's culling (instances culled by their AABB); for code that tests it: Camera3D::get_frustum planes
Frustum.rule: setFromProjectionMatrix → the camera's planes (Plane normal/d as three's, sign of d opposite: three's plane is n·p + c = 0, Godot's n·p = d)

Plane.rule: three Plane(normal, constant): n·p + constant = 0; Godot Plane: n·p = d → d = -constant

Sphere.godot: a center and radius (Godot has no Sphere type)
Sphere.rule: kept as Vector3 + float in the owner's code

Vector3.rule: same axes; applyMatrix4 → Transform3D.xform; lengthSq → length_squared

Matrix4.rule: elements column-major → Transform3D(Basis(cols 0..2), col3); compose → Transform3D(Basis(quaternion).scaled(scale), position)

Euler.rule: three's default order XYZ → Godot EULER_ORDER_XYZ (Godot's default for Node3D is YXZ: say the order)

Color.rule: three's Color components are linear (r152+); set as Vector3/Color params unchanged; a CSS/hex color is sRGB → Color.html(hex).srgb_to_linear()

BoxGeometry.rule: Generate with three's own algorithm (exact vertices) and upload as arrays; BoxMesh differs in UVs

PlaneGeometry.godot: the same arrays (Godot's PlaneMesh lies in XZ, three's in XY)

CylinderGeometry.godot: the same arrays (CylinderMesh UVs and seams differ)

ExtrudeGeometry.godot: the same arrays (triangulated by three's algorithm, run at conversion or ported)

Shape.godot: the path's points; triangulation by Geometry2D.triangulate_polygon (or three's ShapeUtils ported)
Shape.rule: Exact parity needs three's earcut order; Geometry2D gives a valid but different triangulation

mergeGeometries.godot: one surface with the arrays concatenated (indices offset)
mergeGeometries.rule: same result as three's: groups → surfaces

AmbientLight.godot: Exact: three's ambientLightColor uniform (color × intensity, linear) [parity standard-lit]. Native: Environment ambient_light_color/energy

DirectionalLight.godot: Exact: three's directionalLights uniforms (direction in view space, color × intensity) [parity standard-lit, lambert-lit]. Native: RenderingServer directional_light_create

Raycaster.godot: PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D.intersect_ray (colliders) or the owner's own ray–mesh test
Raycaster.rule: three tests triangles of meshes; Godot rays hit physics shapes: keep the triangle test in the owner's code for exact picking

Intersection.godot: the result of the owner's ray test

GLTFLoader.rule: Godot imports glTF 2.0 itself (same axis convention, +Y up, +Z forward)
